title: hostproto-work-order/v1 — the A2A profile payload for this worker
description: The one DataPart a client sends to delegate an assignment. This is the worker's contract, not a HostProto semantic: HostProto objects appear verbatim in the task's artifacts and status messages. A work order that validates but is not yet executable (no url) is an interruption (INPUT_REQUIRED), not a rejection.
